name: codex-mem
description: Local project memory for Codex: capture, search, and consolidate useful experience across sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Recall decisions and lessons across Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Local project memory with a durable background queue, optional multilingual semantic search, and source-linked notes. Observations use fresh Luna/medium sessions through Codex; embeddings run locally. No separate API key.
